description: Gu Yangchun, who betrayed the Orthodox sects, became a demonic human under the Heavenly Demon and lived a life filled with regret and atrocities committed against his will. After the Great Orthodox-Demon War, he is captured by the Orthodox forces and dies after giving Wi Seol-ah information about the Demon Cult. For an unknown reason, Gu Yangchun then regresses to the time when he first met Wi Seol-ah. Determined to live quietly and avoid repeating his past, he soon discovers that the connections and enemies from his previous life are once again drawing near.
author: Ubilam
